checks.name: envelope, descriptor, snapshot, and source-index focused tests
checks.command: python3 -m unittest house.relay.tests.test_snapshot_envelope house.relay.tests.test_snapshot_descriptor house.relay.tests.test_operator_snapshot house.relay.tests.test_preview_index house.relay.tests.test_task_card_index

checks.name: all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

checks.name: static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check changed files && ruff format --check changed files && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: An explicit local persistence and replay verifier for already caller-supplied static documents. It does not discover or refresh sources, scan storage, replace/delete/clean up data, apply retention, read live task/relay state, bind a listener, start a viewer, launch a browser, call iTerm, accept terminal input, create/mutate/dispatch tasks, contact workers/providers, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
